tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List StackPick jobs and the tool slugs ranked in each one. Order matches the category pages. Rankings are never paid.

tools.name: get_best_tools
tools.description: Ranked tools for one category slug, highest score first. Scores and order match the category page. Rankings are never paid.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: One StackPick tool by slug, including its category rank, score, website, and last reviewed date. Rankings are never paid.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side scores and ranks for two or more tool slugs. Each rank is within that tool's category. Rankings are never paid.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search StackPick tools by name, former name, tagline, description, category, or tag. Results use the same score order as the site search.

tools.name: latest_releases
tools.description: Newest StackPick release notes, the same records as the changelog, newest first.
